Degree requirements.

Bachelor of Arts in Technology · 120 semester units · 8 semesters

The Units120 total

Computed from the registry. If these numbers and the prose ever disagree, the numbers are right.

Shared spine (every student)96
Four depth studios in the concentration16
The Crossing: one studio outside the concentration4
Open Studio elective4
Total120
  • Lower division: 66 units. Upper division: 54 units (the minimum is 40).
  • Concentration declared at the end of Year 2 (the Declaration): Media, Design, or Engineering.
  • Field Term (FLD 301), one placed term in Year 3, 4 units.
  • Capstone (CAP 401–402), a defended original work in Year 4, 4 units across two semesters.
  • Physical Culture: graduation-required, non-credit.
  • Teaching requirement: every fourth-year leads first-years in the Workshop, a Canon section, or Physical Culture. Graduation-required, non-credit.
  • Annual gates: a portfolio review and written and oral examination against the five outcomes at the end of each year.
  • Residency and transfer: the Foundation is taken here; no transfer credit is accepted into it.
Status

A working framework, not an authorized degree. SDIT is in its founding phase and is not yet authorized to grant degrees; where authorization stands is published in full. The curriculum is open and free to take.
